program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":   (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # gain CS device gm/Id (large W -> low flicker)
    "L1":      (0.6, 0.3, 1.2),        # gain device L (area for 1/f noise)
    "Isf":     (8e-6, 4e-6, 13e-6),    # source-follower current
    "gmid_sf": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # follower gm/Id
    "Lsf":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # follower L
    "Rf":      (450e3, 400e3, 650e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":      (1e-15, 1e-16, 2e-14),  # feedback cap (peaking trim)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = 10e-6          # testbench reference current (measured 10 uA) = M1 load current
    I1 = iref
    Isf, Rf, Cf = p["Isf"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    vdd = 1.8

    # Gain device biased by the reference current source itself (ideal high-Z load at x)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.4)
    vin = m1.vgs

    # NMOS follower, bulk = vss (vsb = vout)
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=vdd - vin, vsb=vin)
    vx = vin + msf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)

    Rs = vin / Isf        # resistive follower sink (no extra bias branch)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.R("RS", "vout", "vss", Rs)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- analytic prediction ----
    g_x = m1.gds
    A0 = m1.gm / g_x
    asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + 1.0 / Rs)
    Ab0 = A0 * asf
    Cx = m1.cdd + msf.cgd + (1 - asf) * max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0) + 5e-15
    wa = g_x / Cx
    wsf = (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + 1.0 / Rs) / (cl + 0.2 * msf.cgg)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cfe = Cf + m1.cgd

    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 4000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Ab = Ab0 / ((1 + s / wa) * (1 + s / wsf))
    Zf = Rf / (1 + s * Rf * Cfe)
    Z = Ab * Zf / (1 + Ab + s * Cin * Zf)
    Zm = np.abs(Z)
    Z0 = Zm[0]
    idx = np.where(Zm < Z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else float(f[-1])

    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    vn2_th = 4 * kT * 1.0 / m1.gm
    Kfl = 8e-9            # empirical nfet 1/f coeff [V^2*um^2*Hz] (calibrated from iter-1 sim)
    vn2_fl = Kfl / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e6)
    vn2 = vn2_th + vn2_fl
    yin = abs(1 / (Rf / (1 + 1j * w1 * Rf * Cfe)) + 1j * w1 * Cin)
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + vn2 * yin ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(Z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vin,
    }
